definitions.explanation: The part of a garment covering the arm.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}{袖|そで}のシャツを{着|き}る。
{夏|なつ}は{半袖|はんそで}で{過|す}ごすことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In summer, I often wear short sleeves.

notes:
{袖|そで} means sleeve of clothing.

TYPES OF SLEEVES:
- {長袖|ながそで}: long sleeves
- {半袖|はんそで}: short sleeves
- {袖|そで}なし: sleeveless
- {振|ふ}り{袖|そで}: long-sleeved kimono

IDIOMS:
- {袖|そで}を{引|ひ}く: to tug at someone's sleeve (for attention)
- {袖|そで}の{下|した}: bribe (lit. under the sleeve)
- {袖|そで}にする: to cold-shoulder someone
- {袖|そで}{振|ふ}り{合|あ}うも{多生|たしょう}の{縁|えん}: Even a chance meeting is fate

PATTERNS:
- {袖|そで}をまくる: to roll up sleeves
- {袖|そで}を{通|とお}す: to put on (clothes)

COMPOUNDS:
- {袖口|そでぐち}: cuff, sleeve opening
- {袖丈|そでたけ}: sleeve length
